templateVarsNote: JA Eventcamp's T4 custom colours (etc/customcolors.json, written by T4 into its generated stylesheet as --heading_color and --gray_light): its headings and .link-dark titles read --heading_color (#12114a) and its light cards and buttons --gray_light (#edf5ff); the slot points them at the text and surface colours (11/10/2026: titles stayed #12114a on a page that turned dark); its primary gradient (calls to action, the header BUY TICKET link, the + speaker button, the off-canvas header, the menu underline, the active page) is painted !important from its own --gradient_primary_start / --gradient_primary_end (magenta to pink), which no button rule outranks: they stayed the template magenta under every system (visual review 14/10/2026). Both point at the system’s accent and its hover step; the buttons’ labels take the accent’s own text !important (buttonTextImportant, the template sets them white !important: white on a light accent), and the header’s BUY TICKET link (.head-action .navbar-nav li a, not a .btn) the same through followRules
paletteBandsNote: its light bands (speakers, articles) are T4 palette sections painted by T4's generated stylesheet (#edf5ff, links #12114a): they take the surface and the text that reads on it
contrastNote: heading and text: every visible heading and text element, judged element by element against the same element in the template’s own look (flow.mjs samples); block: text set straight in a div that holds only inline content (a hero title, an eyebrow) — outside the heading and text kinds, added at the re-measure of 11/10/2026
keepDefaultsNote: read off the released home page's :root (11/10/2026): the hero slider (.item) keeps its pink kicker (.text-primary reads --color-primary) and its #666 text
keepTextNote: the hero slider and the agenda's day tiles (an orange gradient picture with white labels and an 8%-opacity day number) keep the template's own page text, which they inherit
followRulesNote: the section kicker (#e812b8, from T4's generated stylesheet, out of a release's reach) takes the accent made readable on the page (11/10/2026: pink on MotherDuck's cream, 3.53:1)
maxVersionNote: 1.0.2 16/10/2026 (#1375): re-cut of 1.0.1 with --move-only: a status colour set as text reads the slot's readable shade (--ds-c-<status>-text); nothing else moved, and unworn the page is the release's own (VERIFICATION.json).
bandsNote: drafted 2026-10-12 by scripts/bands.mjs off the released default page (/): each kept band that is not a picture wears the system's ground (src/bands.mjs), its words keep their colours; the countdown band under the hero (and the strip above the footer) is a decor block of its own, .bg-decor-mask.bg-gradient-primary, set behind white words (.text-white): kept, it wears the system’s ground as a gradient wherever the white words read on it (the accent, else the system’s ink), and its corner arcs (a magenta picture on its ::before) take that ground’s hue through mix-blend-mode: luminosity (sideRules). The hero band was keyed .item, a class every Joomla list item carries: on /about-us it kept the speakers’ cards, their names the template navy on a dark page (Moxie); it is keyed by the hero section itself, .t4-sideshow
followNote: the round speaker portraits on /about-us sit in a ring whose top half is hidden by a white mask (.wrap-effect .bg-border .bg-fixed, the template’s page colour): under a dark system it showed as white square corners behind each portrait (visual review 14/10/2026); it takes the system’s page colour
buttonNote: the icon-only round buttons (.action: the arrow in the features; .apply-link: the + in the speakers grid, a 200px circle) are not text buttons: the system’s button padding and radius made them squares with the icon off centre (visual review 14/10/2026). The button selector leaves them out; they keep their circle and take the accent as fills
